verdict.rationale: The SDK documents a single idempotent `provision` call that creates a per-user agent (maritime-docs-2, maritime-docs-45, maritime-docs-18). Each agent runs in its own micro-VM with VM-scoped secret injection, which gives real isolation (maritime-docs-37, maritime-docs-33). However, speed is only documented as 'under 5 minutes' for the quickstart and 'one image pull from live', not seconds (maritime-docs-14, maritime-docs-13), and the product is framed as agent hosting rather than general-purpose sandboxes. Missing for 10: documented seconds-level provisioning or cold-start latency, explicit sandbox-isolation guarantees, an API reference or OpenAPI spec for the provision call (the OpenAPI probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
